#!name=薄荷健康
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0082 / 薄荷健康 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0419 / 薄荷健康去广告 / 可莉🅥[https://github.com/luestr/ProxyResource/blob/main/README.md]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/page_float_bubbles\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/tool_buttons\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/app-interface\/v1\/search\/search\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/status\.boohee\.com\/api\/v1\/merged_messages$/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/bohe\.sfo-tx-shanghai-01\.saas\.sensorsdata\.cn\/api\/v2\/sfo\/user_popup_configs\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/sensor-banners\?/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
移除广场推荐页面横幅 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/plaza-flow\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/BooHee/BooHee_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/page_float_bubbles\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/tool_buttons\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/app-interface\/v1\/search\/search\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/status\.boohee\.com\/api\/v1\/merged_messages$ data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/bohe\.sfo-tx-shanghai-01\.saas\.sensorsdata\.cn\/api\/v2\/sfo\/user_popup_configs\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/sensor-banners\? data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[Body Rewrite]
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v2\/index\? 'delpaths([["data","recom_cards"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v2\/index\? 'delpaths([["data","recom_btns"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/plaza\? 'delpaths([["data","tabs",1,"badge"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/plaza\? 'delpaths([["data","recommend_ads"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["top_banner"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["diagnos_config"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["partner_hospital"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["question_answer"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["product"]])'
http-response-jq ^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$ 'delpaths([["brand_story"]])'

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% api.boohee.com, bohe.sfo-tx-shanghai-01.saas.sensorsdata.cn, lego.boohee.com, status.boohee.com
